title: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with former employee of Regions Bank
raw_text:
August 13, 2026
Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with former employee of Regions Bank
For release at 11:00 a.m. EDT
The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday announced the execution of the following enforcement actions listed below:
Consent Prohibition against Elazia Jones
Former employee of Regions Bank
Check fraud
Additional enforcement actions can be searched for here.
